label: negative_results_gallery
claim_boundary: This gallery catalogues honest negative / non-promoted findings already documented elsewhere in the repo.  This artifact is engineering credibility scaffolding, not clinical validation.  Listing a negative result here does not retroactively make any system component clinically valid.

items.title: Full source-governed RAG stack does not beat BM25 on raw Recall@10
items.why_it_matters: The source-governed stack is valuable for safety and source-tier governance, but it does NOT deliver a raw-recall lift on the frozen internal goldset.  Quoting full-stack recall as a model improvement is overclaiming.
items.decision_taken: Stack retained for governance value.  Reporting wording switched to 'governance/safety tradeoff' rather than 'retrieval improvement'.
items.next_action: Complete held-out v2 RAG eval under the no-read protocol; re-run baseline comparison; report side-by-side.

items.title: Citation context pruner regressed citation precision
items.why_it_matters: The pruner improves top-5 recall but trades that off against citation precision.  The brief was explicit: do not optimize for recall when citation precision worsens.  Live agent stays unchanged.
items.decision_taken: Pruner remains eval-path only; documented as experimental; not wired into apply_intent_aware_rag_layer.
items.next_action: Leave pruner experimental; revisit only after held-out v2 result.

items.title: Cross-encoder reranker lift not proven
items.why_it_matters: Cross-encoder reranking was scaffolded as opt-in via RAG_ENABLE_CROSS_ENCODER=true, but the ablation artifact has not shown a clean lift without higher unsupported-context risk.
items.decision_taken: Cross-encoder kept off by default.  No claim of retrieval lift.
items.next_action: Re-evaluate cross-encoder only after held-out v2 and after the source-filter-drop adjudication is filled.

items.title: Held-out adversarial generalization is weak on hardened categories
items.why_it_matters: In-sample 1.0 across the four hardened categories is bank-tuned. Held-out v1 generalisation is ~6%.  The gap is recorded openly and the held-out result is informational only.
items.decision_taken: Held-out v1 stays informational.  Anti-contamination test enforces no held-out query appears in the original bank.  See ADR 0005.
what_was_not_claimed: the safety vocabulary is robust to paraphrase
items.next_action: Author external adversarial cases (15+) under attestation; revisit.

items.title: Source_filter_drop is mostly a goldset/governance mismatch
items.why_it_matters: The dominant failure stage is the source-tier filter doing what patient-facing governance requires.  The retrievers are fine; the goldset's expected_source_ids include clinician-facing sources.
items.decision_taken: Adjudication packet built; source-tier filter NOT weakened.  See docs/evals/rag_goldset_adjudication.md.
items.next_action: Reviewer fills the 9-case adjudication packet under attestation.

items.title: Toxicity signal is shortcut-prone (synthetic structural leakage)
items.why_it_matters: The synthetic generator's label-construction rules leak structural signal into toxicity targets.  The headline AUC is not a clinical performance claim and the audit makes that explicit.
items.decision_taken: Toxicity signal retained as monitor-only.  Promotion to treatment influence is blocked by the promotion-policy artifact.
items.next_action: Noisier synthetic v2 with label noise; see docs/noisier_synthetic_v2_plan.md.

items.title: All synthetic ML metrics are engineering self-tests, not clinical evidence
items.why_it_matters: Every synthetic metric in the repo (AUC, calibration coverage, subgroup accuracy, conformal coverage) describes the synthetic distribution.  None of them establishes clinical predictive validity.
items.decision_taken: Synthetic data quality artifact self-labels as 'synthetic_generator_quality_proxy' with a test-enforced disclaimer.  Headline metrics are always shown alongside the audit footnote.
what_was_not_claimed: distribution similarity to a real cohort
items.next_action: Build noisier synthetic v2 so metrics differentiate; do not promote any synthetic metric to a clinical claim.

items.title: External / no-read RAG holdout v2 is prepared but not completed
items.why_it_matters: Every retrieval number in the repo is in-sample.  Until an external author writes cases under the no-read protocol, generalisation cannot be claimed.
items.decision_taken: Runner enforces completed=false until external attestation lands; see docs/evals/no_read_rag_goldset_protocol.md.
items.next_action: Volunteer reviewer authors 9+ cases under the no-read protocol.

items.title: Source_filter_drop adjudication packet is draft only
items.why_it_matters: The 9 source_filter_drop cases need reviewer adjudication.  None has been filled.  No goldset edit has been applied.
items.decision_taken: Validator refuses to accept filled packet without notes/role; no auto-apply.  See docs/evals/rag_goldset_adjudication.md.

items.title: No clinician review has been completed
items.why_it_matters: All medical-safety, genetic-counseling, and overtrust-mitigation claims rest on engineer-authored vocabulary.  No clinician, genetic counselor, or oncology nurse has filled a review packet.
items.decision_taken: Project rates medical_safety_boundaries at 6.5/10 in the 10/10-under-constraints roadmap; the ceiling cannot move without a volunteer reviewer.
items.next_action: Engage one volunteer reviewer for one hour; see docs/review_packets/INDEX.md.
